mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by less than 2% over the previous quarter, it signals strong real economic growth without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases < 2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where GDPC1 grows by more than 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by less than 2% over the previous quarter.
